claim: Four writer/reader pairs over eight synthetic sheets (32 cases), including the same-version control (new, new). A template stored by the pinned reader is ACCEPTED by r18.1's read_input in 8 of 8 (computed: the gate does not compare a template with no version member). With HEAD's uploads.py, the pinned reader raises ImportError on READER_VERSION in every case where it is writer or reader (24 of 24 in the world: a loud failure, not a silent one). The control (new, new) is accepted on every re-open. A READER-ONLY move (the pinned uploads with the r18.1 reader) refuses 8 of 8 templates stored by the pinned reader (computed: the pinned read_input compares every member, with no version gate). So the start state of the release pair must move uploads.py and template_reader.py together.
